name: budget-net-worth
description: The owner's net worth today (totals from their account balances) and projected month by month if the budget as it stands holds. Use these figures; do not calculate your own. Read-only.

inputs.months: number? (1 to 24, starting next month; defaults to 6)

outputs.today: object? (netWorth, assets, debts; null when there are no balances)
